apps.name: Deck
apps.subtitle: Wardrive HUD for WDGWars
apps.localizedDescription: Deck is a native iPhone wardriving HUD for WDGWars. Dark neon map, live territory grid, capture progress (Confirmed/Needed), and turn-by-turn while you drive. Sign in with your WDGWars API key (or username + password via the documented login route). Unsigned; Feather signs on-device.

versions.localizedDescription: TrollStore fix: IPA is ad-hoc signed with an embedded application-identifier entitlement (app + Live Activity widget), so TrollStore no longer rejects it. Minimum iOS 16.0. Includes the 1.0.8 iOS 16 map.

Runs on iOS 16 (minimum iOS 16.0, e.g. iOS 16.7.10 via TrollStore). iOS 16 uses an MKMapView Drive map with the same grid, route, car marker, follow camera and compass; iOS 17+ keeps the SwiftUI map. Live Activity needs iOS 16.2+. Widget extension now has its own bundle id so TrollStore accepts the IPA.

Navigation Live Activity with live turn-by-turn directions (Lock Screen + Dynamic Island). Settings and Scanners stay reachable while navigating. The driven portion of the route fades/dulls as you drive while the road ahead stays bright. WDGWars requests now retry with backoff instead of a single timeout ('did not answer'). Silent GPS fallback: phone GPS first, device GPS only when the phone has no fix.

Fixes 'Could not send to the bridge: Resources are insufficient' (needs Deck Bridge firmware 1.0.1, attached to the release). Bridge commands are queued and retried quietly. New Auto GPS per scanner: device location, else the iPhone's GPS. The bridge screen explains when Kismet has no GPS fix.

New ESP32 Bluetooth Bridge scanner: an ESP32-S3 running Deck Bridge joins the Wi-Fi your Kismet box is on and streams Kismet's devices and GPS to Deck over Bluetooth. Pick the bridge, scan for Wi-Fi from it, send the password and the Kismet address + API key, and watch live status. Same dedupe and Wi-Fi-with-GPS-only counting. Works while the phone is locked.

Fixed drive counting (unique IGNORED/NO GPS, beaconing Wi-Fi devices, ESP32 802.11ax). WI-FI and BT stats. Compass in the bottom controls. Opens centered on you. Blue border on the current cell. Follow mode keeps your zoom.
No demo mode. Apple Maps-style location button. Multiple scanners with cross-device dedupe; only Wi-Fi with valid GPS counts.

appPermissions.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Deck shows your position on the WDGWars grid, the square you are in, and turn-by-turn directions while you drive.
appPermissions.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Deck connects to your Deck Bridge (an ESP32-S3) over Bluetooth to receive the networks your Kismet device hears, including while the phone is locked during a drive.

apps.name: Weaselware
apps.subtitle: Wardriving companion for the XIAO ESP32-C5
apps.localizedDescription: Weaselware is the iPhone companion for the Seeed XIAO ESP32-C5 Weaselware firmware: Devices, Dashboard, Wardrive map with Biscuit-style floating +N popups, Wi-Fi/BT scans, and WiGLE CSV export. Unsigned; install via Feather or TrollStore. Minimum iOS 16.0.

versions.localizedDescription: Like Biscuit, the map now clears after each wardrive so the next drive tracks everything again: the trail, pins, Wi-Fi/BT counters, samples and seen networks all reset (when you close the report, or right away if the report is off). Turn it off in Settings › Wardriving › Clear Map After Each Wardrive to keep earlier drives on the map. There's also a Clear Map button on the map and the Wardrive Complete screen (disabled while driving). Your saved sessions, History and CSV/WiGLE exports are never deleted. The Complete screen's 'APs' tile is now labelled 'Wi-Fi samples'.

Fixes the Wardrive Complete screen on iOS 26: the cut-off "D…" button in the top-left is now a clear ✕ close button, and the blank white pill at the bottom is now a full-width "Upload Session" button with an icon and readable text. The same close-button fix is applied to every other sheet (Settings, Devices, History, Console, scans, attack warning), toolbar text buttons can no longer be cut off, and on/off switches use the theme colour instead of white-on-white.

Wardrive popups fixed to match Biscuit: each scan now shows one +N per radio, and the number is exactly how much that counter just went up (blue for Wi-Fi, teal for BT; the counter numbers use the same colours). Popups start at the centre of your location dot and rise straight up with no sideways drift; if Wi-Fi and BT fire together the BT one sits just above. The text has a clear dark outline. The samples lines now update together with the counters.

Wardrive now matches Biscuit: each update shows one popup with the real count (+21, +2…) rising from your location dot — bright blue for Wi-Fi, teal for BT — and the counter jumps by the same amount instantly. The device is checked every second while wardriving. Network pins are off by default (Settings › Wardriving › Network Pins on Map) and a faint blue trail follows you. Fixes popups not appearing in 1.0.16, and duplicate/garbled network rows with firmware 1.1.0.

Firmware Update no longer spins forever: while updating, the app checks the C5 every second and stops with a clear reason (couldn't join the Wi-Fi/hotspot, couldn't download from GitHub, no response, or timed out). Only the button you used shows a spinner. Local file uploads go straight over Bluetooth when the SSID is empty.

Wardrive: device count updates are spread evenly between status reads (now every 2.5 s while wardriving) as steady +1 to +4 popups for both Wi-Fi (green) and BT (blue), never one big jump. Popups rise from just above your blue location dot and follow it. Stop now asks inside the HUD (Stop / Keep going) instead of a system popup. Dashboard shows the app version. Firmware update: Use current Wi-Fi fills the SSID, and the Wi-Fi password is saved per network in the iOS Keychain (with Forget).
The Stop wardrive? confirmation now appears at the Stop button instead of at the top of the screen under the Dynamic Island. Includes 1.0.14's Biscuit-style paced +1 to +4 wardrive popups.

Wardrive HUD now streams networks in like Biscuit: new Wi-Fi and BT networks tick in as small +1 to +4 popups (green Wi-Fi / blue BT) with the counter and map pins in step, instead of one big jump per scan sweep or device STATUS update. Final totals and the Complete sheet are unchanged.

Wardrive Complete sheet and history now match the live HUD counts (captures or device STATUS, whichever is higher). Distance now accumulates during the drive. Floating green Wi-Fi / blue BT +N popups now actually appear over the location dot (fixes invisible popups in 1.0.12).

Biscuit-style floating +N popups on the wardrive map (green Wi-Fi / blue BT) anchored over the location dot. Deltas come from live captures and STATUS counts so the HUD still animates when DATA rows are sparse. Keeps iOS 16.0 support and TrollStore application-identifier fakesign.
TrollStore fix: IPA is ad-hoc signed with an embedded application-identifier entitlement, so TrollStore no longer rejects it. Minimum iOS 16.0. Includes the 1.0.10 iOS 16 maps. Keep firmware 1.1.0.

Runs on iOS 16 (minimum iOS 16.0, e.g. iOS 16.7.10 via TrollStore). iOS 16 uses MKMapView versions of the Wardrive, Geofence and route-preview maps; iOS 17+ keeps the SwiftUI maps. Keep firmware 1.1.0.
Status diag in Console (bleSub/txSent/txDrop/notifyFail). Requires firmware 1.1.0 which fixes the empty wardrive map (NimBLE handle 0).
Poll Response READ drain for wardrive DATA rows when GATT notifies fail; HUD shows Status counts while captures catch up. Requires firmware 1.0.9.
Firmware Update screen now shows a live progress bar and percent while uploading and flashing a .bin to the C5.

Fixes: .bin file picker now selects any file (public.item); Check for Updates reads the public firmware manifest; Biscuit-matched colors/layout; live scan/sniff recording with phone GPS; WiGLE 1.6 export.
Fixes: .bin file picker now allows selecting .bin files; added haptics and pressed/in-progress feedback to buttons.
Fixes: Dashboard battery shows live %, Quick Actions coloring, and live Wardrive HUD/map (WiFi/BT counts and map points update during a wardrive).

Five-tab app matching the Weaselware UI, with a real battery monitor (voltage → %, pack-size → time remaining, low-battery alert). New: Firmware Update — upload a local .bin from the app (OTA firmware update). Includes Forget device to re-pair and a 2100 mAh battery default.

Five-tab app matching the Weaselware UI, with a real battery monitor (voltage → %, pack-size → time remaining, low-battery alert). New: Forget device to re-pair (clears the saved C5 so it can be re-discovered and paired fresh), and a 2100 mAh battery default.

Five-tab app matching the Weaselware UI, with a real battery monitor (voltage → %, pack-size → time remaining, low-battery alert). New: Forget device to re-pair (clears the saved C5 so it can be re-discovered and paired fresh), and a 2100 mAh battery default.

appPermissions.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Weaselware shows your position on the wardrive map and tags captured networks with GPS.
appPermissions.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Weaselware connects to your XIAO ESP32-C5 over Bluetooth to receive scans and battery status, including while the phone is locked.

apps.name: BetterBMS
apps.subtitle: CyberCase JBD BMS monitor & control
apps.localizedDescription: BetterBMS is the iPhone app for the CyberCase JBD BMS: live cell and pack monitoring (per-cell voltage bars with active-balance highlight, current, SoC, temperatures), MOS charge/discharge control (charge-only, both on, discharge-only, verified by FET readback), and parameter editing for the 4S JBD SP04S075 BMS. Unsigned; Feather signs on-device. Minimum iOS 17.0.

versions.localizedDescription: First Feather release of BetterBMS for the CyberCase pack (4S6P Molicel P45B, JBD SP04S075). Includes the MOS discharge-off fix (EEPROM 0x2D switch bit cleared, FET state confirmed by readback), balance ON/armed/off status, and Real Time cell bars with active-balance highlight.

appPermissions.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: BetterBMS connects to your JBD / Xiaoxiang BMS over Bluetooth to show live battery data and send the passcode the official app never asks for.

news.title: Deck 1.0.4
news.caption: Accurate drive counts, WI-FI/BT split, compass in the bottom controls, opens on your location, blue current-cell border, zoom stays put while following.

news.title: Deck 1.0.3
news.caption: No demo mode, Apple Maps-style location button, multiple scanners with dedupe and GPS-only Wi-Fi counting.

news.title: Deck 1.0.2
news.caption: Cell tap popup, compact neon HUD, Held by <gang>, Nets needed to capture (Confirmed/Needed), and no more 'Network error: cancelled'.
